## ✅ How to Approve Pending Access Requests

### Step-by-Step Process
*(IIQ-Lifecycle-Manager-App-Access-Requests, p. 1 & 4)*

1. **Navigate** to the **Approve Access Requests** page:
   - Click the **"Approve Access Requests"** QuickLink card on your Home page, **or**
   - Select **Approve Access Requests** from the QuickLink menu.

2. **View your pending approvals** — the page shows all approvals assigned to you, including those from any workgroups you belong to.

3. **Review each approval request**:
   - Check for any **Policy Violation alerts** displayed at the top of the approval (a violation alert appears if approving would cause a conflict).
   - View access recommendation icons (if AI-Driven Identity Security is enabled).
   - Click **Comments** to view or add comments on the approval or individual items.

4. **Make a decision** — you can act at the overall request level or item by item:
   - **Approve All** — approve all items in the request.
   - **Deny All** — deny all items in the request.
   - **Approve / Deny** individual items one at a time.
   - **Forward** — forward the approval to another user.

5. **Electronic Signature** *(if configured)*:
   - If your installation requires an electronic signature, the **Electronic Signature dialog** appears automatically. Use the same credentials you use to log in.

6. **Complete the approval** — the **Complete Approval dialog** displays after clicking Approve All / Deny All, or after deciding on the last individual item.

> 💡 **Tip:** Approvers can also **view and change start/end dates** on request items as part of the approval process *(IIQ-Roles-Temporary-Access-Dates, p. 5)*.
